## Summary

The 2026-05-01 [[stripe]] Terminal fleet guide covers on-reader tip settings through the Dashboard and the Configuration API. The 2026-11-07 base capture links to separate Dashboard and API variants.

## Key Details

**Tip modes in May**. The reader displays three suggestions before the customer presents a payment method. Smart tips switch between three percentages and three fixed amounts based on the pre-tip amount. The other modes display three percentage suggestions or three fixed amounts.

**Dashboard in May**. From a location’s details or the Manage locations page, open its configuration and edit or override **Tipping**. Choose the mode and currency, enter the suggestions, then select **Review**, **Confirm** and **Apply changes**. In this Dashboard section, Stripe says it applies the settings on the reader within 10 minutes.

**API in May**. Create or update a Configuration object with tipping settings keyed by currency. The USD example uses `tipping: { usd: { percentages: [...], fixed_amounts: [...], smart_tip_threshold: 1000 } }`. The separate on-reader guide explains that this example shows fixed amounts below USD 10 and percentages at or above USD 10. It also requires the same configuration keys for each currency in a multicurrency Configuration.

terminal-fleet-tipping.text: Customize the tipping options displayed on your readers.
before customers present their payment method.
Stripe applies the tipping configurations on the reader within 10 minutes.
You can specify on-reader tips when creating or updating
The reader dynamically displays three percentages or amounts, depending on the size of the pre-tip amount.
Click **Edit** or **Override** next to the **Tipping** icon.
Click **Review** to view your changes, then click **Confirm**.

terminal-fleet-tipping.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping, the complete 2026-11-07 capture states the goal of customizing suggestions displayed on the reader and offers Dashboard and API variants. Those lines do not establish prerequisites, actor roles or state transitions (new raw lines 5-14). The 2026-05-01 capture says the reader displays three amounts or percentages before the customer presents a payment method. Smart tips switch between those types based on pre-tip amount. The other modes display three percentage or fixed amounts. A fleet operator can edit or override Tipping for a location in Dashboard, choose mode and currency, then select Review, Confirm and Apply changes. The May Dashboard section says Stripe applies the configuration to the reader within 10 minutes. An API integration can create or update a Configuration with currency-keyed tipping settings. The USD example includes percentages, fixed_amounts and smart_tip_threshold (old raw lines 8-12, old raw lines 18-41, old raw lines 43-88). The revised source-stripe-terminal-tipping-config retains the API fields and modes and restores the dated Dashboard route, with the reader timing scoped to that section and the threshold framed as a USD example.
terminal-fleet-tipping.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping, source-stripe-terminal-tipping-config adds the 2026-11-07 Dashboard/API index as dated navigation. The index changes how the base page directs readers to the variant material and establishes no change to the implementation (old raw lines 14-16, old raw lines 43-47, new raw lines 5-14). The 2026-05-01 guide remains the source for the Dashboard location paths and scoped within-10-minute timing. The word 'passcode' in the location-details instructions is an editorial inconsistency with the explicit Tipping control and supplies no passcode prerequisite. The API example supplies USD values without establishing a universal cents contract (old raw lines 18-41, old raw lines 47-85). The revised source keeps the reciprocal stripe-terminal-tipping route and links the separate on-reader and Configuration sources. The 2026-11-07 on-reader capture documents fixed amounts below USD 10 and percentages at or above, plus the same configuration keys across currencies and reader-specific timing (raw/stripe-terminal-features-collecting-tips-on-reader-2026-11-07.md lines 92-98 and 128-130). The separate configuration guide supports account defaults and location overrides (raw/stripe-terminal-configurations-2025.md lines 8-26). On-receipt tipping remains a separate feature.

concept_suggestions.anchor: On-reader tip options are configured at the fleet level via the Configuration object (same account→location hierarchy). Set `tipping: { usd: { percentages, fixed_amounts, smart_tip_threshold } }` per currency. Propagation: 10 minutes. See [[source-stripe-terminal-tipping-config]].
